cards.text: Zechariah, a prophet the word of the LORD came to (Zechariah 1:1), has a new message, and it's called a burden. It's aimed at the land of Hadrach and at Damascus, its resting place, for the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel are on somebody.

cards.question: The burden against Hadrach and Damascus says the eyes of men and of all the tribes of Israel are on the ___.

cards.text: The burden keeps rolling to Hamath, which borders it, and then on to Tyre and Sidon, though they are very shrewd. Friend, this message has more stops than a delivery truck.
Tyre has built herself a fortress and heaped up silver like dust and gold like the dirt of the streets. Friend, I spent YEARS in a junk drawer counting dust, and not one speck of it was silver.

cards.question: Tyre has her fortress and her piles of silver and gold, but this burden is against her. What does the Lord say He'll do to her?
Tyre's fortress will keep her safe from fire.

cards.text: The Lord will cast her wealth into the sea, and fire will consume her. Ashkelon, a Philistine city, will see it.

cards.question: When Ashkelon sees what happens to Tyre, it will celebrate.

cards.text: Ashkelon will fear. Gaza will writhe in agony, and so will Ekron, because her hope will wither.

cards.question: In all this, Gaza will lose her king.

cards.text: Ashkelon will be left with no one living there, and a mixed race will move into Ashdod, another Philistine city.

cards.question: After all the silver, the gold and the fortress walls, the LORD says He'll cut off something of the Philistines. What?

cards.text: Then the LORD says something more about the Philistines. He'll remove the blood from their mouths and the abominations from between their teeth.

cards.question: Once the LORD removes the blood and the abominations from the Philistines' mouths, what will they become?

answers.text: Servants of the city of Tyre

cards.question: The Philistines will become like a clan in ___.

cards.text: Even Ekron will be like the Jebusites, the people who ended up living among Judah in Jerusalem (Joshua 15:63). One minute they're on the burden list, the next minute they've got a name tag that says COUSIN.
Then the LORD makes a promise about His own house. He says He'll camp around it because of an army, because of those who march to and fro.

cards.question: The LORD says never again will an oppressor overrun His people. Why not?

answers.text: He keeps watch with His own eyes
Their walls will be too high
Their army will be too strong

cards.text: Now the whole mood changes. A call goes out to the Daughter of Zion and the Daughter of Jerusalem, because somebody's on the way.

cards.question: With somebody coming to Zion, the Daughter of Zion and the Daughter of Jerusalem are told to rejoice greatly and shout in triumph.

cards.text: Why all the shouting? Their King is coming to them, righteous and victorious, and humble too.

cards.question: A King who's righteous, victorious and humble is coming to Zion. What's He riding?

cards.text: I had the trumpets lined up, and the King comes humble, on a colt, the foal of a DONKEY. The Gospel of Matthew says this was fulfilled when Jesus rode into Jerusalem (Matthew 21:4-10).
Then the LORD says He'll cut off the chariot from Ephraim and the horse from Jerusalem.

cards.question: With the chariot and the horse cut off from Ephraim and Jerusalem, what will happen to the bow of war?
With the chariot cut off and the bow of war broken, the King will proclaim ___ to the nations.
The King's dominion will stop at the borders of Jerusalem.

cards.text: His dominion will reach from sea to sea, and from the Euphrates to the ends of the earth. Friend, that's more stops than the burden had, and the burden had a LOT.
Then the LORD speaks of "your prisoners" in a waterless pit, and of the blood of His covenant. Friend, I spent years in the dark at the back of a junk drawer, so this one hits close to home.

cards.question: Because of the blood of His covenant, what will the LORD do for the prisoners in the waterless pit?
Once they're released, the LORD tells the prisoners to return to their stronghold.

cards.text: He calls them prisoners of hope, and even today He declares He'll restore to them double. That's the expired coupon I shared a drawer with, friend: way past its date and STILL believing.
Then the picture turns to battle. The LORD says He'll bend Judah as His bow and fit it with Ephraim.

cards.question: With Judah as His bow, the LORD will rouse the sons of ___ against the sons of Greece.
The LORD rouses Zion's sons against the sons of Greece. What will He make Zion like?

answers.text: The sword of a mighty man

cards.question: In the battle, the LORD will appear over His people, and His arrow will go forth like ___.

cards.text: The Lord GOD will sound the ram's horn and advance in the whirlwinds of the south.

cards.question: With the ram's horn sounding, what will the LORD of Hosts do for His people?

cards.text: They'll destroy and conquer with slingstones, and they'll drink and roar as with wine.

cards.question: The LORD's people will be filled like sprinkling bowls.

cards.text: They'll be drenched like the corners of the altar. On that day, the LORD their God will save them as the flock of His people.

cards.question: Like ___ in a crown, the LORD's people will sparkle over His land.

cards.text: They'll sparkle over His land like jewels in a crown. Sparkle, one of my cookie cutter kids, used to cry happy tears at every birthday batch, and friend, I'm right there with her on this one.

cards.question: After all that, the LORD's people end up worn out and hungry.

cards.text: How lovely they will be, and how beautiful! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine, the young women.
